QuestInfo.name: Traveling Around Maple 7
QuestInfo.0: After carefully observing Omega Sector, I should start up a conversation with Jr. Officer Medin.
QuestInfo.1: Scadur offered to take me back to Lith Harbor. Once I get there, I better get back to Olaf...
QuestInfo.2: I met up with Olaf again. What's this creepy scroll for...?

0.0: Alright, how was Omega Sector? Did you like it there? Well, you seem to have traveled and observed a whole bunch of diverse towns here. Are you ready to go back to Lith Harbor now?

yes.0: Alright, I'll take you back to Lith Harbor.
yes.1: Once you return to Lith Harbor, talk to #eOlaf#n and he may give you something very interesting.

no.0: You must have some unfinished business to take care of here. Let me know when you're ready to leave this place.

1.0: Oh, that was fast. How was it? Did you get to realize just how huge this world really is? Alright, here'a small gift for you.
